section_summary.extract_value: This section describes the development of Brazilian Portuguese translations of the CEMS and IES-2 instruments following a five-step cross-cultural adaptation process. Two pre-test phases were conducted with 10 participants each; the first pre-test revealed that 80% of participants had difficulties with the CEMS's original 6-point scale, leading to a revision to a 5-point scale that was successfully validated in a second pre-test with 50% male participants. No main study data, demographic characteristics, or correlation analyses are reported in this methodological section.
